units: <cite ref="Nazir 22b:2">Naz. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>כי מתפיס … בצ׳ מתפיס</he> (Rashi <he>בצינ׳</he>) when a man takes hold (of a dish), does he do so when it is in its original condition (as it is cooked), or when it is cooled off?, i.e. when referring to a thing in a vow, is the vowing person presumed to mean the thing when it is yet prohibited (as flesh of a peace-offering before the blood is sprinkled), or when it has become permitted?; [<cite ref="Nedarim 11b:8">Ned. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>בהיתירא</he>, a gloss that took the place of our w.; Ar. reads <he>בצְנָפָא</he>, q. v.]
